review_notes: All10 root ImageGen sources viewed by root and art owner.60 genuinely new actor poses plus16 independently drawn FX states. Whole source alpha components selected with exact bbox/area, never blind grid crops. Tiny detached sub3px alpha specks omitted. Colors at alpha<128 are preserved only in raw source and cleared by Aseprite export. Fixed body ruler for every source, manual hip x/ground registration; war Chen uses crown-to-own-robe core and virtual scroll ground explicitly.
